text:
Priority: high
Make Athena faster (BRIEF.md addendum of 2026-10-25, 'we need to be faster'). First measure, from the records of jobs since 2026-10-23, where a job's wall time goes: reading, planning rounds, producer runs and send-backs, Athena's checks, the verifier, and landing (the pull request's CI, about 13 minutes, which reruns fmt, clippy and the full test suite Athena already ran on the same tree). Then cut the three largest avoidable costs, for example letting land accept Athena's own recorded checks on the pull request's exact tree instead of waiting for CI to repeat them where the host rules allow, running independent jobs of a plan group in parallel, and making the full suite faster. Report the median job time before and after.
Acceptance:
- docs/decisions.md records the measured breakdown (marked measured, from the records) and the chosen cuts with their alternatives.
- Each cut has a test, and none removes a check that would let a failing candidate land.
- The before and after median wall times are stated, after measured on jobs run after the change.
Files: crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, .github/workflows/ci.yml, docs/decisions.md, CHANGELOG.md
